+To: ubuntu-devel-announce@lists.ubuntu.com
+Reply-To: ubuntu-devel-discuss@lists.ubuntu.com
+Subject: <CODENAME> (to be <VERSION>) Beta Freeze
+
+As of a short while ago, <CODENAME> has entered the Beta Freeze, with a goal of
+releasing Beta images sometime late Thursday. *From now until the Beta is
+released, please only upload updates for packages on any release images if you
+/need/ to get them into the Beta itself.* Please hold off with everything else
+until after we release on Thursday.
+
+The queue freeze will last from now until the final release next month, which
+means that all seeded packages will now need a spot-check and review in the
+queue from a release team member before they are let into the archive.
+
+As with the previous releases, we have a bot in place that will accept uploads
+that are unseeded and don't affect images. Don't take this as an open
+invitation to break Feature Freeze on those components. This is just to reduce
+the burden on the release team, so we only review the uploads that need very
+serious consideration. If you find the bot is blocking an upload that you think
+should have been auto-accepted, let us know, and we'll sort it out.
+
+We will be spinning a set of Beta candidates in the next 12 hours or so.  We
+then encourage people to start testing ASAP for their favourite flavor(s) as
+they come off the line.
+
+Happy bug-hunting from now until the final release, and please do help out and
+test images, etc., where you can, and let us know what's broken in your
+environment(s).
+
+As a reminder, the Beta images will appear on the ISO Tracker here:
+
+   http://iso.qa.ubuntu.com/qatracker/milestones/<NUMBER>/builds
+
+On behalf of the Ubuntu Release Team,

+To: ubuntu-devel-announce@lists.ubuntu.com, ubuntu-release@lists.ubuntu.com
+Reply-To: ubuntu-devel-discuss@lists.ubuntu.com
+Subject: <CODENAME> (<VERSION>) Beta milestone reminder
+
+Hello everyone!
+
+This is a gentle reminder about the nearing Beta milestone for <CODENAME>
+(<VERSION>) next week, along with the usual Beta Freeze happening next Monday.
+Please make sure to get as much as possible into the release pocket before that
+time: the Beta is usually a great occasion to test how things are looking
+before the release. The closer the Beta is to our final product, the better.
+
+## Target bugs to the Beta milestone
+
+The authoritative list of bugs that are to be fixed for the Beta is the
+Launchpad beta milestone [0]. Please target any bugs that are to be fixed for
+the beta to that milestone. Mark potential release blockers as Critical.
+
+## Package inconsistencies
+
+Please, help to eliminate package inconsistencies that may be present in the
+archive, namely uninstallable packages [1] and "not built from any source"
+(NBS) packages [2].
+
+## Documentation
+
+Please update documentation for the Beta and the upcoming final release.
+In particular, make sure the release notes and the upgrade documentation
+are up to date.
+
+## Flavors
+
+Flavors should update their -meta packages for the new release.
+
+## Reach to the Release Team
+
+Feel free to reach out to the Ubuntu Release Team on Matrix: find us
+in the #release:ubuntu.com channel.
+
+Thanks!
+
+[0] https://launchpad.net/ubuntu/+milestone/ubuntu-<VERSION>-beta
+[1] https://ubuntu-archive-team.ubuntu.com/proposed-migration/<SERIES>_uninst.txt
+[2] https://ubuntu-archive-team.ubuntu.com/nbs.html

+Hello translators!
+
+<ADDITIONAL UPDATE CONTEXT>
+
+Updated language packs are available in <CODENAME>-proposed as version
+<LANGPACK VERSION>. They will be moved to <CODENAME>-updates on <LANGPACK RELEASE DATE>
+for all languages except those languages where we identify issues with
+the proposed language packs.
+
+To help review and test the updated translations, install the language
+packs for your language from <CODENAME>-proposed and report here any issues.
+The language packs for that language won't be moved to <CODENAME>-updates
+until the issues have been considered and/or resolved.
+
+The names of the language packs copied to <CODENAME>-proposed are:
+
+    language-pack-XX
+    language-pack-XX-base
+    language-pack-gnome-XX
+    language-pack-gnome-XX-base
+
+where 'XX' is the language code.
+
+The purpose of a manual test is to make sure that the system keeps
+working normally, and that there are no noticeable translation errors
+that stand out. How to test: log in into an Ubuntu desktop session
+and make sure that the core features behave as expected. Example check
+points:
+
+* Open the Activities overview, enter some search terms (for example,
+home, netw, update).
+
+* Check the menu at the top right of the screen.
+
+* Start the file browser (Files > Home Folder). Check your home folder
+location, the menu items, and the side bar.
+
+* Start Update Manager: check that it runs and has sensible user
+interface.
+
+Please, report any issues you find here by <LANGPACK RELEASE DATE>.
+
+Thank you!

+      Release Team checklist says to ask IS to remind mirror operators to check their
+      free disk space since the disk usage will be increasing.
+
+      Publishing the images will require XGiB of extra disk space for cdimage.ubuntu.com,

+    description: |
